privacy.overviewText: Leikvellir is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our playground discovery platform for Iceland.
privacy.keyPointsText: We collect minimal data necessary for the service, use cookies for analytics and functionality, and never sell your personal information.
accountInfoItems: Account creation and last login timestamps
userContentItems: Playground submissions (location, title, images, equipment details)
locationDataItems: Approximate location (when voluntarily shared for distance calculations)
Location data is stored locally in your browser and not sent to our servers
privacy.cookieUsageText: We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience and understand how our service is used. Here's a breakdown of our cookie usage:
privacy.essentialCookiesText: Required for basic functionality. Cannot be disabled.
privacy.analyticsCookiesText: Help us understand usage patterns (via PostHog).
privacy.functionalCookiesText: Enhance your experience with the platform.
privacy.thirdPartyCookiesText: From external services we integrate with.
privacy.managingCookiesText: You can manage your cookie preferences using our cookie banner or through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may limit some functionality.
serviceFunctionalityList: Calculate distances to playgrounds (when location is shared)
analyticsImprovementList: Understand usage patterns and popular features
Identify and fix bugs or issues
Plan new features based on user needs
privacy.dataSharingText: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share information only in these specific circumstances:
privacy.legalRequirementsText: When required by law or to protect rights and safety
privacy.publicContentText: Approved playground submissions are publicly visible on the map
privacy.contactUsText: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or want to exercise your rights:
privacy.privacyNotice: This privacy policy may be updated periodically. We will notify users of significant changes via email or through the application.
